user.title: Connect to Stuffy Meter
user.description: Enter the monitor's IP address or .local hostname. Admin password is optional and only needed for Reboot and Firmware Updates.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered Stuffy Meter
zeroconf_confirm.description: Add {name} ({host}) to Home Assistant? Admin password is optional and only needed for Reboot and Firmware Updates.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Stuffy Meter
reconfigure.description: Update the monitor's host or admin password. Leave the password blank to keep the existing one.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Stuffy Meter
reauth_confirm.description: The admin password for {name} ({host}) was rejected. Enter the updated admin password (or leave blank if authentication was disabled on the monitor).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the monitor. Check the IP/hostname and ensure it is on the same network.
error.invalid_device: The host responded, but it does not look like a Stuffy Meter.

abort.already_configured: This Stuffy Meter is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered Stuffy Meter.
abort.invalid_device: The discovered device did not return a valid Stuffy Meter status.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The host belongs to a different Stuffy Meter.

init.title: Stuffy Meter Options
init.description: Adjust the local polling interval or enter a new admin password (leave blank to keep the existing password).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the monitor to verify the password.
error.invalid_device: The monitor did not return a valid status.

auth_required.message: Admin password is required for this action; update it in Stuffy Meter integration options or reauthenticate.

ota_already_in_progress.message: A firmware update is already in progress on this monitor.

ota_not_started.message: Firmware update did not start on the monitor.

ota_reboot_timeout.message: Monitor did not come back online after firmware update reboot.

ota_connection_lost.message: Lost connection to the monitor during firmware update.

ota_timeout.message: Timed out waiting for firmware update to complete.
